Definition: Parosh, the name of our Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Parosh or Pharosh = "flea"; 1) ancestor of a family who returned from exile with Zerubbabel and a 2nd group who returned with Ezra; 2) a leader of the people who signed the covenant with Nehemiah
